Steps in Taxol biosynthesis catalyzed by taxadiene synthase (a), taxadiene hydroxylase (b), taxadienol O-acetyltransferase (c),

label: Figure 2
caption:
FIG. 2.
Conversion of the 4(20)-ene-5a-acetoxy functional grouping
to the 4(20)-epoxy-5a-acetoxy functional grouping and rearrange-
ment to the oxetane D ring of Taxol.

label: Figure 3
caption:
FIG. 3.
Mass spectral fragmentation pattern of the biosynthetic product of the acetyl transferase reaction. The spectrum is identical to that
of authentic taxa-4(20),11(12)-dien-5a-yl acetate; the ions at m/z 330 (P1), 315 (P1-CH3), 287 (P1-CH3CO), 270 (P1-CH3COOH), and 255
(P1-CH3COOH-CH3) are diagnostic.

label: Figure 4
caption:
FIG. 4.
Time course of acetyl CoA:taxadienol acetyl transferase
activity and Taxol levels measured in extracts of untreated (control)
T. cuspidata suspension cell cultures and cultures following induc-
tion with methyl jasmonate. Acetyl transferase activities in nonin-
duced (I) and induced (}) cells and Taxol production levels in non-
induced (F) and induced (Œ) cells are plotted. The 0 h time point
corresponds to the enzyme activities and Taxol levels from cells
harvested immediately prior to methyl jasmonate addition. For de-
tails of the isolation and assays, see Experimental Procedures.
